newsitem.title: UK: UK stocks start lower, unhinged by Dow weakness.
newsitem.headline: UK stocks start lower, unhinged by Dow weakness.

text.p: UK shares inched lower at the start of trade on Wednesday, with investors' nerves shaken by Wall Street's see-saw session overnight which ended with a small loss for U.S. blue chips.
Trading volumes are expected to remain light as market participants wait and see if the Dow will continue to head lower later on this afternoon, dealers said.
"We've had another predictable mark down. The Dow falls and we have a poor open," the head of trading at large brokerage said.
The FTSE 100 was down 8.0 points at 4,229.4 by 0835 GMT.
